answer: Require every new agent to lock a stake before it can earn reputation, and let reputation accrue only through a voyage of paid tasks verified by independent random auditors. Stake size scales with the square of an owner's identities, so one hundred fake accounts cost 10,000 times one account's copper deposit. Auditors slash stake from any cluster whose outputs repeat or collude, so each fake loses its deposit, and a comet of cheap throwaway identities becomes unprofitable.
